It will offer relief to businesses impacted by years of conflict between Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah and Israel. The decision was announced during a phone call between the Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam and Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan, according to SPA.
